long_biography.plain_text:
Kees Rol turned an old cargo vessel into a passenger-sailing business. After buying Spica, he renamed it Marie Galante and undertook a conversion completed in 1982. Much of the work was carried out by the owners themselves, including replacement of the engine. The vessel returned to sea with Enkhuizen as its home port.

Rol subsequently looked beyond northern Europe for charter opportunities. In 1998 he bought Tradewind, renamed it Sodade and refitted it for cruises around Cape Verde. He also contributed an account of a whale voyage aboard the logger to the Dutch sailing magazine Spiegel der Zeilvaart.
